```{r}
dataset <- housepi::survey
dataset$sex <- ifelse(dataset$sex == 1, "M", "F")

hhsampler <- HouseholdSampler$new(
  age = list(breaks = c(0, 12, 25, 50, 100)),
  sex = list(levels = c("M", "F"))
)
```

$$
p_{1}P(\theta) + (1-p_{1})P[n\vert n>1]P({\theta_{1}},{\theta_{2}})\prod_{k=2}^{n}P({\theta_{k}}\vert{\theta_{1}},{\theta_{2}}) 
$$

```{r}
hhsampler$compute_household_marginals(dataset)

hhsampler$generate_households(5)
```
